segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination/acne-prone skin report the product is moisturizing without breaking out the t-zone or causing shine.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin, whose skin is irritated by nearly every serum, reports no irritation with this product.

concerns.redness: Two reviewers mention redness; one reports the product knocks it down a bit, another reports the witch-hazel-paired routine causes no added redness.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe the product as hydrating or moisturizing, restoring hydration after actives and adding hydration to a routine, with no dissent.
concerns.blemishes: One combination, acne-prone reviewer reports no breakouts or clogged pores; no other reviewer discusses blemish outcomes.

extraits.texte: I'm a skincare junkie and very particular about what I keep and what goes back. This is like a serum/toner hybrid. Very moisturizing and soothing. Knocks my redness down a bit. No breakouts/clogged pores, no burning. I notice a positive difference. Doesn't pill under makeup. I have combo, acne-prone skin. Will buy again... I like it better than Paula's Choice, Fresh, and Mario Badescu.

I use this toner along with a basic witch hazel (astringent) and i have to say it refreshes and clarifies/"locks-in" my skin after being cleansed. It does tingle a bit but doesnt burn, i assume its because of the witch hazel. Doesnt cause any redness for me either.
Every serum in the market has irritated my skin except this one. So this is a keeper for me. Not sure about the long-term effects, though.

This tonic has a gel consistency that is very satisfying for application. My combination skin feels great with it on. It's moisturizing but doesn't break out my t zone or make ne look shiny. It's soothing, and my skin feels so soft. I've been using the collagen one, and I love them both so I just might rotate.
This tonic is amazing! Perfect for restoring my skin's hydration after using active ingredients. It's literally a tonic, essence and serum in one!

I've been using the Glow Tonic for years and will continue using it, but I wanted to add more hydration to my regimen! This new antioxidant tonic is wonderful. The texture took me by surprise! It feels soothing and very hydrating. A definite addition for those looking to add hydration. And don't forget to periodically spritz the rose tonic throughout the day! Thanks Pixi

extraits.titre: A little bit goes a long way
extraits.texte: I like this toner and serum because the product is smooth and absorbs well into the skin. It goes well with a nice moisturizer. The product gives a nice glow. I mostly use this product during the day.

reserve: Only ten reviews are available and most do not specify skin type or concern in detail, so conclusions are based on a small, self-selected sample.
